title: Government collapse and institutional deadlock
trigger: A government falls or prolonged negotiations prevent a stable governing coalition.
focus: Trust in parliament and government; election turnout.

title: Systemic financial crisis
trigger: A severe financial crisis weakens the economy and public finances.
focus: Economy, political trust, turnout and party fragmentation. Radical vote shares are in notebook 03.

title: Integrity scandal at the top
trigger: A major scandal reaches the head of government or governing parties.
focus: Trust in parties and government; changes in the party system.

title: Electoral-integrity shock or foreign interference
trigger: A major challenge to the integrity or validity of an election.
focus: Trust in elections and institutional constraints.

title: Concentration of executive power
trigger: Executive power expands over time, weakening checks and constraints.
